notes.title: ONLY A FEW MORE DAYS UNTIL THE AsRPG Collection DROPS! + Pax & Waypoints Events
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="vwwhsni_wbc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This incredible journey has finally come to an end...[/p][p]or is it just the beginning?[/p][p][/p][p]The AsRPG Collection, featuring 3 RPGMaker2003 games (Norman Jones, Professor Frippel & Miodesopsia), will be dropping September 26th![/p][p]
Furthermore, I would like to officially announce that the AsRPG Collection will be receiving support and updates for some time after release, so please let us know of any bugs or issues you find.[/p][p][/p][p]The first updates, 1.0.1 for all 3 games, is scheduled to drop a week or 2 after release.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Now, for something different![/p][p][/p][p]AsRPG Collection and Zero Point Games will be at Waypoint Constellations, an event in Sydney NSW (Australia) - [b]Tue, 14 Oct.[/b][/p][p]To know more and get your FREE tickets, [url="https://events.humanitix.com/waypoint-constellations"]Click Here.[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577077/e8509dd15e32f7a2208215ac2a23d3299e25d25e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Zero Point Games will also be at PAX AUS 2025[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577077/95f8b969c92c77a91e6c751ac042da6fe87089ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We will be presenting [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3476600/Zero_Point_Survivor/"]Zero Point Survivor[/url] together with our UNSW colleagues.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Hope to see you soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577077/0cc2033e9262133aacd9c3bafd3217f8d0159382.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.content: [p]The A.R.P.G. Collection is releasing September 26th 2025![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="M50uY3CXNUk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]I would like to thank everyone who came to visit us at [url="https://smash.org.au/"]SMASH!Con[/url] 2025, in Sydney ICC.[/p][p]Thank you for wishlisting this game and playing the DEMO at our stall.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577077/f08cb5f82a83db2fa0b5ad0fd56efdc1ab76af0f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577077/cf94a35a99d7d6fa0906424955b2110f76eb7051.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For you, a gift, you can print it and stick it on your wall...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577077/6e2cc7523620b7882c711c426a627df05ecc0388.png"][/img][/p][p]: )[/p][p][/p][p]By the way check out our new Socials![/p][list][*][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/zeropoint.games/"]INSTAGRAM[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@alieno_zeropointgames/video/7512712943562165522"]TIKTOK[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/zeropoint_games"]TWITTER / X[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://zeropoint.games/"]ZEROPOINT.GAMES website[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]I will be updating the screenshots on the Steampage soon.[/p][p]Until then-hey, who are you? wha̵t̸ ̴a̷r̵e̷ ̵y̴o̶u̶ ̵d̸o̸i̶n̵g̴ ̶h̶ḩ̸̸̵̡̛̛̗̘̤͔̣̫͓̲̯̺͖̦̟̰̪̝̳̲͔̮͙̣͒̓͛̒͑̓̂̑̈́̐̄̍͑͋̌̓̿̾̕̚͘͜͝͠͝͠͝ẹ̸̴̷̡̱̦͚̝͖͕͎͖̩̝̜̼̲͇̪͕̽̃́̐̏̅̀͐̃̏̌̓̄̈́̑̽̓̌̈́͘̕͜͝͝͝ė̶̸̸̛̟̤̺͖̤͍̳̓̎̈́̒͂̉̊̓̾͌̀͘̕r̷̵̵̨̛̗̙̩̭̭̻̼̲͇̬͉̫̳͍̗͖̪͉̩̰̘̹̟̯̗̗͓͗͂̋͛̾͐̈́̓̂͗̓̓̂̐̉͛̃́͌͌͊́͌̅͘̕̕͠͠ȇ̷̴̴̡̼̞̰̦͔̥̮͎̥̠̯̖͇̯͚̽̿̒̾́̎̏̔̀̂̏͐͑̇̀̚͘̕͘͜͠͠?̷̵̵̢̨̛͚̝̫͇͍̝͉͓͎̟̗̘̥̯̟͈̬̖̠͔̳̘̣̤͖̤̓̀͋͗͋͐̈́̈̌́̀̎̅̓̕͝͠ͅ?̴̵̶̧̨̡̩͕̺̻̤͔͙̣̘̗͕͚̰̇̽̌̔̋̔̍̈́̆̎̓̓̆̂̽̚͜͜͝͝͠!̵̸̸̡̡̡̛̰̲͕̩̣͍̫̗͇̫̱͍̤̩͈̠̖̻͛̈́̃̾̎̂͌̆̔̒͑̽̊̃́̊͆́̓̌̽̔͑̈́̚͜͝͝͠?̵!̸[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577077/d3206e15cdc59bccba6839bbf31de743bd12d7ea.gif"][/img][/p]
